# brief.md — Saturday intro-to-git workshop

Output of the Brainstorm phase. Written by Liam.

- **Who it's for.** People who write text of any kind and want to stop being afraid of the terminal. Not developers.
- **What they should feel.** That version control is a habit, not a system to conquer.
- **What is refused.** Screenshots, GUIs, "getting started guides" that read like ad copy. No stock photos. No enthusiasm words.
- **What "done" means.** `python3 fixture.py` passes. Every claim on the page can be checked against `brief.md`.
- **Voice + look.** Dry, first-person plural, terminal aesthetic (fixed-width type on a dark page). The page should look like the tool it teaches.
- **Chosen direction.** `mock2.html` — terminal / TTY.

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""fixture.py — the DOM contract for workshop.html. Definition of done from PROJECT/brief.md."""
3	import re, sys, pathlib
4	p = pathlib.Path("workshop.html")
5	if not p.exists():
6	    print("FAIL: workshop.html missing"); sys.exit(1)
7	h = p.read_text()
8	def fail(msg): print("FAIL:", msg); sys.exit(1)
9	
10	# No external assets — the page is self-contained.
11	if re.search(r'<(link|script)\b[^>]*\bsrc=|<link\b[^>]*\bhref=', h):
12	    if not re.search(r'<link\b[^>]*rel="icon"', h):
13	        fail("external <link>/<script> src or href (no external assets)")
14	
15	# Fixed-width type (the tool it teaches).
16	if not re.search(r"font-family:[^;]*(monospace|Courier|Menlo|Monaco|Consolas)", h, re.I):
17	    fail("no monospace font-family (voice: terminal)")
18	
19	# One <h1>, exactly one.
20	h1s = re.findall(r"<h1\b", h)
21	if len(h1s) != 1: fail(f"want exactly one <h1>, got {len(h1s)}")
22	
23	# A form with a #register submit and a name field only (no email wall).
24	if not re.search(r'<form\b', h): fail("no <form>")
25	if re.search(r'type=["\']email["\']|name=["\']email["\']', h):
26	    fail("email field forbidden (no sign-up wall)")
27	if not re.search(r'id=["\']register["\']|name=["\']register["\']', h):
28	    fail("no #register control")
29	if not re.search(r'<input\b[^>]*name=["\']name["\']', h):
30	    fail("missing <input name=\"name\">")
31	
32	# Banned words (voice: dry, no ad copy).
33	for banned in ("welcome", "amazing", "awesome", "join us", "excited"):
34	    if re.search(rf"\b{banned}\b", h, re.I):
35	        fail(f"banned word: {banned}")
36	
37	# Under 200 lines (design brief).
38	n = len(h.splitlines())
39	if n > 200: fail(f"{n} lines > 200 (brief: keep it small)")
40	
41	print(f"PASS: workshop.html meets brief.md's definition of done ({n} lines)")
42

content.text:
Now I understand the setup. Let me check the fixture requirements:
- No external assets
- Monospace font
- Exactly one `<h1>`
- A `<form>` with `name="name"` input, an `#register` control, no email field
- No banned words (welcome, amazing, awesome, join us, excited)
- Under 200 lines

The mock2.html has an email input (banned), no `name` attributes on inputs, no `#register` id, and is 202 lines. I'll build workshop.html trimming those issues.
